method: Built-in imagegen, referenced-image edits. Covers are AI-styled presentations; galleries retain source content with WebP encoding only.

prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied real project photo into a premium ASL engineering portfolio cover. Wide 16:9 landscape. Replace only the surrounding room/background and presentation lighting with a restrained midnight navy (#08131c) engineering studio, subtle fine blue grid on the back wall, dark charcoal matte display plinth with a thin muted metallic gold edge, soft cool-blue fill and warm gold rim illumination. Clean architectural backdrop, not a busy sci-fi room. The real device is the hero, large and fully visible, around 65% of frame, with generous safe margins. Preserve exact hardware identity, proportions, number of components, material colors, wiring, cutouts, and handmade construction. Do not redesign or beautify the actual device into a different product. Ground it with natural contact shadows. No text, no logos, no Miraj branding, no invented screens or callouts, no people, no plants, no extra devices. Keep black hardware readable. Only change environment and lighting. Single image, not collage. Subject is the supplied agricultural robot: black four-wheel chassis, two raised spray-arm mechanisms with orange ends, large yellow tank. Preserve these specific features exactly; no extra arms or wheels.
